test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following language institutes is located in Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya**

 
 
• ​The goal of the** Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya**, a central university founded in 1997, is to advance Hindi language and literature via study and instruction.
 
• With numerous **national** and **international **organisations, the** Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya** has engaged in a number of significant research initiatives that are conducted in Hindi.
 
• There are eight schools at **MGAHV University**, including the schools of law, education, languages, and management. The university provides over** 45 courses** through the numerous departments housed within these schools.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On January 8, 1997**, **the President** approved a** parliamentary act **that established the **university**. The act's goal was to create and incorporate a teaching university for the advancement of** Hindi literature** and **language**.
 
• With numerous national and **international organisations**, the** Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya** has engaged in a number of significant research initiatives that are conducted in **Hindi**.
